name: token-diet
description: Aggressive token reduction for OMP dev teams: ctx-wire for transparently compressed + secret-scrubbed shell output, CodeGraph (MCP) for symbol/call-graph queries instead of grep+read, a caveman terse-output skill, and a yagni minimal-code skill (ponytail-style). Layers on top of OMP's native compaction + astGrep/summarizeCode.
